title: Govett-Brewster Art Gallery and Len Lye Centre
geometryBasis: Named 228-vertex footprint retaining the actual steel curtain fold pattern, including turns and rear returns. Queen and King Street fix the geographic sides.
sectionBasis: Project architect documents 14 m columns with steel cladding and glazing between. The July 2020 exterior controls the relative gallery height, old facade panel rhythm, curved entrance canopy and glass doors.
limitations: The model represents the connected galleries in July 2020, from the adjoining stainless-steel Len Lye Centre to the historic gallery entrance.

The named polygon provides the outline and curtain profile. The architect describes the 14 m cladded columns. The date-matched photo controls the cream facade, canopy and street finishes. Rear service details and relative roof sections are estimates.
The original Terrarium ground remains intact. Contact uses approximate paving at the Queen Street entrance.
